books.title: The Great
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.description: A classic American novel set in the Jazz Age. The story of Jay Gatsby and his obsessive love for Daisy Buchanan serves as a critique of the American Dream.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.author: Harper Lee
books.description: A gripping tale of racial injustice and childhood innocence in the American South. Scout Finch's perspective reveals themes of morality and compassion.

books.author: George Orwell
books.description: A dystopian social science fiction novel presenting a totalitarian regime. It explores themes of government surveillance, propaganda, and personal freedom.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.description: An exploration of how Homo sapiens came to dominate the world. Harari examines history from the Cognitive Revolution through to modern times.

books.title: The Selfish Gene
books.author: Richard Dawkins
books.description: A groundbreaking work in evolutionary biology that introduced the concept of the gene as the unit of selection in evolution.

books.title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.description: A comprehensive guide to writing clean, maintainable code. Martin shares principles and practices that make code readable and professional.

books.title: A Brief History of Time
books.author: Stephen Hawking
books.description: A landmark volume in science writing, exploring cosmic mysteries from the Big Bang to black holes in accessible language.

books.title: The Code Breaker
books.author: Walter Isaacson
books.description: A biography of Jennifer Doudna, one of the Nobel Prize-winning scientists who created CRISPR. It explores the ethics and impact of genetic engineering.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: A timeless novel about Elizabeth Bennet's romantic journey and the complex social dynamics of Regency England.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.description: An exploration of the two systems of thought that drive human decision-making, with insights into biases and heuristics.

books.title: The History of Science
books.author: William Dampier
books.description: A comprehensive overview of scientific development from ancient times through the modern era.

books.title: The Design of Everyday Things
books.author: Don Norman
books.description: A fascinating exploration of how good design makes everyday objects more usable and enjoyable.
